title: Unresolved LIFO Stack
summary: Keep unresolved items so the most recently added unresolved item is handled before older ones.
recognition_signals: the newest unresolved item must be resolved first
nested structure must close in reverse opening order
undo or recursive-style work follows last-in-first-out order
core_rules: The top of the stack is the only unresolved item eligible to resolve next under the LIFO contract.
structural_steps: inspect the stack top when a resolving event arrives
reject or act if the top does not match
pop when the top is resolved

common_confusions.distinction: A stack resolves the newest waiting item first. A queue processes the oldest discovered or waiting item first.
